set.body: Attach explicit locus spaces to exact volume domains; back VoxelRegion and VoxelSelection with the shared membership and ordering semantics; split volume searchlight relation construction from ROIVolWindow materialization. Acceptance follows phase 5 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md: checked space mismatch, closed balls, valid radius zero, metric laws, value filtering outside geometry, legacy differential tests, and image plus downstream JVM and Scala.js gates.
set.title: Locus 5: migrate image regions and volumetric searchlights
